# pangolin_label (Resource)

A label for organizing sites, resources, private resources and clients. Attach it with `pangolin_label_attachment`. Requires Pangolin 1.25 or later. Import using the format `<org_id>:<label_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_label.example acme:5`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_label" "production" {
  org_id = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  name   = "production"
  color  = "#3b82f6"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Hex color, e.g. `#3b82f6`.
- `name` (String) Label name, unique per org regardless of case.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the label belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `label_id` (Number) Pangolin-assigned label ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_label.example acme:5
```
